name: Extra Rivenspell
body:
You have learned an additional way to rive spells.

Prerequisite: Archon 1

Benefit: You gain one additional rivenspell ability. You must meet all the rivenspell ability’s prerequisites.

Special: You may select this feat more than once. Each time you do so, you learn one additional rivenspell ability.
